aiDescription.summary: The bill requires foreign payment stablecoin issuers with over $50 billion in consolidated issuance and not subject to SEC Section 13(a) or 15(d) reporting to prepare GAAP annual financial statements that disclose related‑party transactions and to obtain annual audits conducted under PCAOB auditing standards by registered auditors. It amends section 18 of the GENIUS Act and clarifies this requirement does not alter PCAOB jurisdiction over permitted payment stablecoin issuers or auditors.

impact.summary: Foreign payment stablecoin issuers with over $50,000,000,000 in consolidated outstanding issuance that do not file SEC reports under sections 13(a) or 15(d) must prepare GAAP annual financial statements disclosing related‑party transactions. They must engage a registered public accounting firm to audit those statements under PCAOB auditing standards, including auditor independence, internal controls, and related‑party rules.

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs. (Sponsor introductory remarks on measure: CR S653-654)
